content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Aerospace components and valves, pumps and composites; does not make or recondition industrial shipping containers or packaging."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"MRO and test-equipment distributor with outsourced supply chain services; no container manufacturing, reconditioning or timberland."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Industrial MRO distributor and pump repair business; does not manufacture packaging or manage returnable containers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Welding and cutting consumables and equipment; a different product set and customer base from industrial packaging."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves and mechanical seals for plant fluid handling; no packaging, container reconditioning or timber business."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves, brake friction products and connectors; no industrial packaging or container services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Papermaking machinery and wood processing equipment; makes equipment for mills rather than packaging products."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Metalworking tools and MRO supplies distributor; sells consumables rather than making or reconditioning industrial containers."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Paints, coatings and specialty materials; a chemical coatings business, not packaging or container management."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Specialty process fluids, lubricants and coatings with technical services; chemicals rather than industrial packaging."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Locks, hinges and metal hardware components; no containers, packaging or reconditioning services."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Coding and marking printers and water quality instruments; equipment and consumables, not industrial packaging."}]}
